stories.headline: BTC's second push toward $87k stalls under the late-September high
stories.blurb: Bitcoin nearly reached $87k on Sunday, within ~$500 of its eight-month high near $87.4k, then slipped back under $86k. — The 7-day bull case now needs a daily close above ~$87.4k; repeated stalls there keep the range intact.

stories.headline: Weak jobs report eased hike bets, but yields climbed right back
stories.blurb: September payrolls came in far below expectations, yet the 10-year yield rose back above 5.3% on Monday as markets look to next week's CPI. — Rising long yields and a firmer dollar are the main macro headwind capping crypto's upside.

stories.headline: Spot ETFs log a third positive week, then a Monday outflow
stories.blurb: US spot BTC ETFs took net inflows for the week to Oct 2 (led by IBIT); Farside shows Monday Oct 5 back in outflow. — Institutional demand is supportive but not accelerating — flows are mixed rather than a fresh tailwind.

stories.headline: On-chain profitability turns up: two BlockHorizon signals flip Bullish
stories.blurb: Supply in Profit and long-term-holder NUPL flipped Bullish on Oct 5, and all 16 signals are rising over 30 days, but the Cycle Index is still Bearish at 6/16. — On-chain is starting to back the price move; a breadth push past half the signals would be the confirmation to watch.

stories.headline: Fed liquidity still draining until Thursday's print
stories.blurb: The latest weekly Fed balance-sheet print (Wed 09-30) showed liquidity contracting; the Treasury's cash pile has fallen since, which eases the drain. — If Thursday's release confirms the turn, the main structural headwind fades; a second contracting week keeps the 1-month outlook cautious.
